name: standing internal rotation slide with towel
description: A standing towel slide on a stable tabletop that gently trains shoulder internal rotation.
instructions: Stand beside a stable counter or box and place a small towel beneath your hand on its surface.
Keep your working elbow comfortably bent and close to your side.
Slide your hand inward across the surface as your shoulder rotates, without twisting your trunk.
Slide back slowly, complete the set and switch arms.
